none: Contains: (ff. 2r-5r) Prologue by Jerome. - (ff. 5r-7r) Prologue and chapter list of the Gospel of Matthew. - (ff. 8v-14r) Canon table. - (ff. 14v-75v) Gospel of Matthew. - (ff. 76r-77r) Prologue and chapter list of the Gospel of Mark. - (ff. 78v-117v) Gospel of Mark. - (ff. 120r-125r) Prologue and chapter list of the Gospel of Luke. - (ff. 124v-189v) Gospel of Luke. - (ff. ff. 190r-191v) Prologue and chapter list of the Gospel of John. - (ff. 192v-237v) Gospel of John. - (ff. 238v-251v) Capitulary.
Origin and date: According to Bischoff 2004: "Saint-Amand, IX. Jh., 3./4. Viertel".
Script: Written at Saint-Amand Abbey, Saint-Amand-les-Eaux.

Binding: Post-medieval binding. - Rebound using medieval techniques (1987): full leather over wooden boards; bookblock sewn on four split leather thongs; two eye-and-pin fastenings (long-strap, closing to front board edge).

Flyleaves (2 ff.) are kept in a conservation folder: fragments of a missal (Low Countries, southern part, 14th century), parchment, pen-flourished initials, 297x236 (214x150) mm, 2 columns, 23 lines, littera textualis. - Other fragments from the same codex: BPL 2514: B 78 (offset still in BPL 80) and BPL 120 (flyleaf).
Also described by MMDC and A.W. Byvanckgenootschap (database RKD, The Hague).
New Testament: Gospels (Latin); France, northern part ; Arras? ; St. Amand Abbey?, 9th century, c. 875; BPL 48
